records.text: A Special Air Mission flight with call sign SAM000 flew from Joint Base Andrews to Colorado Springs on August 25, 2025, 16 days before Charlie Kirk was killed
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: On August 25th, 2025, this is 15, 16 days before Charlie Kirk was killed. There was a flight on this jet from D.C. to Colorado Springs with that important and rarely used call sign, SAM-000.

records.text: The SAM000 flight went from Colorado Springs to Las Vegas, arriving at 4:48 PM local time on August 25, 2025
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: Whoever flew under this incredibly highly sensitive call sign, SAM-000, on August 25 flew from Joint Base Andrews to Colorado Springs, home of the 10th Special Forces Group. It stayed in Colorado Springs for three hours, and then it flew to Las Vegas, arriving there at 4.48 p.m. local time.

records.text: On or about December 1, 2023, Corby Hall and FoldAR's COO drove from Texas to Colorado Springs at Victor Marx's request to demonstrate the FoldAR.

He writes that on or about December 1st, 2023, at the request of Victor Marx, Melody (Corby Hall's wife and FoldAR COO; surname unverified), my then-girlfriend, who earned her place as COO of FoldAR, and I drove from Texas to Colorado Springs to provide a demo of the FoldAR to Mr. ... Marx.

verification.notes: In a later on-record interview, Hall again says he and his then-partner drove from East Texas to Marx Colorado Springs property around December 1, 2023 and demonstrated FoldAR to those present. This is a firsthand public account, but the exact date and invitation remain primarily supported by Hall.
